remarks: Gorgeous 1 Bedroom condo located in the heart of Stamford with plenty of sunshine and beautiful views from the balcony. (8th Floor). Great Condition, great location. "HARDWOOD" flooring throughout. Walk to Stamford Downtown, library, mall, shops and restaurants. Easy access to public transportations, I-95 and N.Y. Metro Train. Quick access to N.Y. City. Heat, Hot Water, Cooking Gas, Gym, all included in rent. Laundry and Gym in the lower level. Enjoy Stamford Views From Your very Own Balcony. A reserved Parking space is available for an additional $95 per month. Broker, Client related.
